item.title: [GAGA International] THE POTENTIALS Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
DIRECTOR:
Shoichi Morimoto, Takuma Sato "Any Crybabies Around?"
CAST: Go Morita “Between the White Key and the Black Key” “Lust in the Rain”
Release in Japan: October 30, 2026

Synopsis:
Tsuchiya is a manga assistant who has drifted into his 40s still working under the successful artist Yoshizumi, having never managed to publish his own work.
He quietly watches as his much younger colleagues go independent one after another, while there is something about the new assistant, Yamada, that just doesn’t sit right with him.　Meanwhile, Ushioda, an editor at a publishing house, has hit her 30s feeling increasingly out of place. Having joined the industry simply out of a vague fondness for manga, she struggles with the gap between herself and her passionate colleagues. To make matters worse, she discovers that the new work of Yoshizumi has been snatched away by a rival publisher.　Upon learning that Tsuchiya will not be part of Yoshizumi’s next project, Ushioda approaches him with a proposal: to develop a brand-new manga together with Yamada.

item.description: In the remote South Korea village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok (Hwang Jung- min) and officer Sung-ae (Hoyeon) are called to find a mysterious creature that has wreaked havoc on the village. In the nearby forest, a coterie of hunters, including Sung- ki (Zo In-Sung) set out to track the beast and find themselves hunted instead. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

item.title: [GAGA International] SHIRANUI Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Written, Directed and Original Story by: Ryo Katanosaka
Music by: Taro Umebayashi
Theme Song by: Ichiko Aoba
Animation Production by: CoMix Wave Films

Release in Japan: August 21, 2026

Synopsis:
“Shiranui is the divine light that can grant you only one wish.”
Summer 1996 – Minato, a 10-year-old boy, is neglected by his alcoholic father and keeps to himself at home in a town by the sea. His only source of solace is Ben-chan, a girl deity who appears on Benten Island. As Minato faces a new life in an orphanage and a painful parting from Ben-chan, he makes a wish to Shiranui for her. However, growing hatred toward his father gradually turns the wish into a malicious "curse" against him…

item.title: [GAGA International] PART-TIME DEATH ANGEL Super Teaser Trailer - English Subtitled
item.description:
Director: Mai Sakai
Screenplay by: Kaho Fukuda
Cast: Daigo Nishihata, Riko Fukumoto
Release in Japan: Autumn2026

Synopsis: After his father’s arrest shatters his once-stable life, college student Shinji falls into deep despair. One day, he is approached by his classmate Yuki, who invites him to join a strange part-time job—working as a “Death Angel.” The job involves resolving the lingering regrets of the departed who cannot move on, and guiding them peacefully into the afterlife. Although skeptical at first, Shinji gradually regains hope as he helps each of the departed fulfill their final wish and pass on. Just as their part-time work seems to be going well, a secret Yuki has kept hidden is revealed, bringing an unexpected turn to their lives.

item.title: [GAGA International] UMAMUSUME: PRETTY DERBY – BEGINNING OF A NEW ERA | Official Trailer - In Theaters February 27
item.description:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Beginning of a New Era is coming to North American movie theaters February 27!
Official Site: https://movie-umamusume-newera-en.com

Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Beginning of a New Era
Produced by Cygames and CygamesPictures
Directed by Ken Yamamoto

Jungle Pocket, known to her close friends as "Pokke," is a free-spirited Umamusume who has proven her dominance in the freestyle racing scene. Overwhelmed by Fuji Kiseki's majestic performance at a graded Twinkle Series race, she resolves to take on the Twinkle Series herself.

Shortly after joining the Umamusume training school Tracen Academy, Pokke comes under the wing of Tanabe, a veteran trainer who fostered Fuji Kiseki's talent. Together, they aspire to dominate the Triple Crown series, a set of three races that can only be attempted once in a lifetime. Awaiting them are formidable rivals of Pokke's generation, whose talents surpass even her own.

There's Dantsu Flame, whose diligence and determination to win are second to none; Manhattan Cafe, who chases the shadowy silhouette of a "friend" that only she can see; and Agnes Tachyon, a veritable mad scientist seeking to push the very boundaries of what is possible for Umamusume.

These four runners take to the track with their very pride, spirit, and souls on the line. Past the finish of their epic clash is a door waiting to be opened—one that leads to the beginning of a new era.

"It doesn't matter who stands in my way! I'm gonna be the greatest!"

item.title: [GAGA International] LABYRINTH Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Directed by: Shoji Kawamori "Macross" "Aquarion" franchise
Cast: SUZUKA (ATARASHII GAKKO!)
Character Design: Risa Ebata
Screenwriter: Taichi Hashimoto
Animation Studio: SANZIGEN
Release in Japan: January 1, 2026

Synopsis:
Shiori is an ordinary high school girl yearning for viral fame on social media. One day after a crack forms on her smartphone, her real-life self is replaced by her digital counterpart, “SHIORI,” who emerges from the smartphone world. Trapped in the smartphone world instead, Shiori is powerless and forced to watch as her counterfeit self energetically rises to stardom as a pop icon and influencer. With the help of Komori, a mysterious rabbit-man she meets in this digital wonderland, Shiori must navigate an eerie and surreal cyber labyrinth to get back to her reality.

item.title: [GAGA International] THE BIRD IS CALLING Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Directed by: Katsuhide Motoki “Mission Impossible: Samurai” “Recall”
Original Novel by: Kou Hara
Starring: Koshi Mizukami “Till We Meet Again on the Lily Hill"
Mizuki Yamashita “6 Lying University Students"
Release in Japan: October 3, 2025

Synopsis: Yuji and Yuriko’s peaceful life shatters when an old diary belonging to Yuji’s great-uncle Sadaichi, who died in the war, is discovered. The pages are full of an obsession with life... and one strange phrase: “I want to devour the bird—Hikuidori.” From that day on, eerie phenomena start to haunt those connected to the diary. As the nightmare deepens, a strong will to live—once buried with Sadaichi—begins to twist the past and bleed into reality.

item.title: [GAGA International] ONE LAST THROW Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Director: Jun Akiyama “Soul at Twenty”
Cast: Takaya Matsutani, Kyoka Suzuki
Release in Japan: November 28, 2025

Synopsis:
Shintaro Yokota, at 18, fulfilled his childhood dream with a dazzling pro debut. Embraced by a loving family and his team, he had a bright career lay ahead—until something felt wrong with his vision. A medical examination delivered a diagnosis no young athlete should ever hear: a brain tumor. Driven by a single desire to play baseball and supported by those who never stopped believing in his comeback, he fought on until his final game, which saw a miracle no one had imagined. The true story of Yokota that continues to move and inspire us all.

item.title: [GAGA International] MT. FUJI AND HAPPINESS CODE Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Directed by: Kenji Nakanishi “Dreaming of the Meridian Arc”
Cast: Issei Mamehara (JO1), Yoshie Ichige “Fragments of the Last Will”, Kyozo Nagatsuka “Teki Cometh”
Release in Japan: October 24, 2025

Synopsis:
Takuma, an undergraduate, has just started living with his grandmother, Fumiko, who lost her husband, Ishi, two months ago. Fumiko, with a surprise gift that Ishi left her for their 50th wedding anniversary, enrolls in university. Although initially unfamiliar with the experience of starting university later in life, she begins a joyful new chapter. As Fumiko and Takuma work to unravel another mystery left behind by Ishi, a puzzling equation believed to be connected to Mt. Fuji which Ishi loved to paint, they come to know the last message of his life.

item.title: [GAGA International] My Special One Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Directed by: Ayato Matsuda
Original Comic by: Momoko Koda “My Special One” (SHUEISHA INC.)
Starring: Mei Hata “And Yet, You Are So Sweet”, Kazuya Ohashi
Release in Japan: June 20, 2025

Synopsis: Sahoko, an unremarkable high school girl, despises good-looking boys and has sworn off love after experiencing deep emotional pain. But her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets Kouta, a gorgeous pop star. As she gets to know his passion for his fans and his kindness, she realizes that he is different from the boys who have hurt her. Despite her strong resolve, she finds herself falling for him. However, Sahoko learns that Kouta, too, has made a firm decision in his heart to avoid special bond due to his own painful past.

item.title: [GAGA International] A PALE VIEW OF HILLS Trailer - English subtitled
item.description:
Directed by: Kei Ishikawa “Gukoroku - Traces of Sin”, “A Man”
Original Novel by: Kazuo Ishiguro "A Pale View of Hills" Nobel Prize winner, “Remains of the Day”, “Never Let Me Go”
Starring: Suzu Hirose “Our Little Sister”, “The Third Murder”
Fumi Nikaido “Himizu”, “My Man”, Disney+ Series “Shogun”
Release in Japan: September 5, 2025

Synopsis: UK 1982. An young aspiring Japanese-British writer plans to write a book based on her mother Etsuko’s post-war experiences in Nagasaki. Haunted by the suicide of her older daughter, Etsuko begins to recount her memories from 1952 as a young mother-to-be. Her story begins with her encounter with Sachiko, a young woman full of hope about starting a new life abroad with her young daughter Mariko, who now and again mentions memories of an eerie woman. The writer finds troubling inconsistencies as she pieces together the mementoes of her mother’s Nagasaki years with the memories Etsuko shares.
